story.title: The Unspoken Debt
story.logline: A teenager discovers his family's wealth is sustained by trading their own spoken secrets, until he uncovers the ultimate cost.
story.twist: The secrets his family traded were actually fragments of his own forgotten memories.
story.ending: What happens when you run out of things to forget?

scenes.narration: My family never speaks our true secrets out loud, because every hidden truth has a literal price.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18 years old, messy brown hair, wearing a black hoodie, stands inside a sleek, modern, quiet living room.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's lips, rapid push-in

scenes.narration: My father sits at the glass table, sliding a glowing glass jar across the surface to the buyer.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, watches anxiously in the same sleek, modern living room.
scenes.camera: Medium shot tracking the moving jar

scenes.narration: Inside that jar swirls a dense blue mist. That is my mother's confession of theft, sold for a fortune.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, stares intently at the glowing blue jar in the brightly lit room.
scenes.camera: Macro shot focusing on the glowing mist

scenes.narration: We live like royalty in this concrete mansion, buying our luxury with the weight of our guilt.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, walks past high-end art in the massive, sterile hallway.

scenes.narration: Today, it is my turn to pay the rent. I sit down and press my hands against the extraction plate.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, sits at a metallic desk with a glowing glass plate in the same hallway.

scenes.narration: The machine hums to life, pulling a bright silver thread of memory straight from the back of my skull.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, flinches as a silver light pulls from his head at the metallic desk.

scenes.narration: I watch the silver thread coil inside the jar. It is a memory of my seventh birthday. My only good one.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, gazes tearfully at the silver coil on the metallic desk.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the glowing glass jar

scenes.narration: Except the buyer shakes his head and slides the jar back. He says I have already sold this exact moment.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, looks up in absolute confusion at the metallic desk.

scenes.narration: He taps the glass, and the memory replays. It is me, years ago, selling my own future to keep us rich.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, stares in horror at the glowing projection above the metallic desk.
scenes.camera: POV shot looking at the glowing projection

scenes.narration: I am not paying for our life with secrets. I am paying for it with pieces of a soul I no longer own.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 18, messy brown hair, black hoodie, sits completely alone in the dark, empty metallic room.
scenes.camera: Extreme wide static shot, slowly pulling away

caption.hook: Every luxury had a hidden memory attached.
caption.title: The Unspoken Debt
caption.caption:
Generational wealth always demands a sacrifice, but some currencies are far too personal to spend. When every whispered secret traded away turns out to be a stolen piece of your own childhood, how much of yourself is left to inherit?

Would you keep the fortune or reclaim your past?
